preconditions.description: The number of queries must be between 1 and 10.
The number of nodes must be between 2 and 1000.
The number of edges must be between 1 and the maximum possible edges for n nodes.
Each edge must connect nodes within the range of 1 to n.
The starting node must be within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output must contain distances for n-1 nodes excluding the start node.

postconditions.expression: all(d in {6, 12, 18, -1} for d in stdout)
postconditions.description: Each distance must be either 6, 12, 18, or -1.

postconditions.expression: stdout[i] == -1 if i + 1 not in reachable_nodes else stdout[i] == 6 * (reachable_nodes[i + 1] - 1)
postconditions.description: The output must correctly reflect the distance to each node based on reachability and edge weight.
